title: Technical SEO - Part 1
description: Technical SEO covering keyword research, on-page optimization, structured data, sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical URLs, Core Web Vitals, page speed, and analytics with Google tools. This submodule covers: SEO fundamentals, Keyword research, On-page SEO, Technical SEO, Meta tags.
learning_outcomes: Understand SEO fundamentals and how search engines work
Perform keyword research and competitor analysis
Optimize on-page elements: titles, meta descriptions, headers
